_doc: adaptive_config_v3.json = Phase-4 CANDIDATE policy space record (sweeps on tuning scenarios E-H, selection on held-out I-L; see Reports/phase4_policy_sweep.md). This file documents the swept grid; the SELECTED operating point lives in adaptive_config_v4.json.

candidate_grid.tau_low_tau_high: empirical tertiles (1/3, 2/3) of the agreement score over tuning frames E-H

findings_on_tested_configuration.margin: margins up to 0.07 let one harmful predicted flip through on both tiers; 0.10 suppressed it and scored best
findings_on_tested_configuration.dwell: no measurable effect (single isolated flips only); inherited value 3 kept
findings_on_tested_configuration.confidence_band: banding at inherited margins reproduced the margin=0.10 result while keeping switching possible for high-agreement large-gain cases
findings_on_tested_configuration.temporal_features: median |lag-1 autocorr| of ACS prediction error = 0.138 -> no clear evidence; frame-only models retained
